title: Shortest routes
statement: A road network has n towns (1..n) and m two-way roads. The first line holds n and m (n <= 20000, m <= 60000). Each of the next m lines holds u v w: a road between u and v of length w (1 <= w <= 1000). Print, on one line separated by spaces, the shortest distance from town 1 to every town 1..n, or -1 for a town that cannot be reached.
